fact: UNSD and UNDP held a seminar and training workshop in Freetown on 14-16 May 2024 on using administrative data sources for official statistics, and participants developed a roadmap for sharing administrative data between institutions.
title: High-level seminar and training workshop on the value of data sharing and the use of administrative data sources for official statistics production
